issue_context.title: CBOE Custom Data Uses One-Minute Period
comments:
#5252 introduced a bug because we need to remove `.AddDays(1)` from `Time` [definition](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Data/Custom/CBOE/CBOE.cs#L94).
The one-day delay is handled by [`Period = TimeSpan.FromDays(1);`](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Common/Data/Custom/CBOE/CBOE.cs#L33)
